description: Which external sources do search-enabled LLM APIs surface for a given set of questions?

_help.dataset: Names the output namespace: results land in data/<dataset>/. Give each distinct study its own name so their raw responses never collide. Override for a one-off run with the AUDIT_DATASET env var. If omitted, falls back to `experiment`, then "default".
_help.models: Define any model here. `provider` must be a key in providers.PROVIDERS (openai, gemini, perplexity). `model_id` is the provider's own slug. Optional `options` is passed to the adapter; see each adapter's docstring for the keys it reads. Adding a model needs no code change.
_help.active_models: Which of the above a bare `runner.py` run uses. Override with --models.
_help.conditions: search_on runs with the provider's web-search/grounding tool enabled; search_off runs the same prompt with no tools. Models whose API always retrieves must set supports_search_off: false.
_help.runs_per_prompt: Repeats of an identical prompt. Values above 1 measure retrieval nondeterminism; provider default temperature is used so repeats actually vary.
_help.max_cost_usd: Soft ceiling. Checked between calls, so in-flight calls still land and overshoot is bounded by roughly workers x cost-per-call.
